canonical.title: Character lodging within taxi range of Agnes (Sint-Martens-Bodegem)

parent.title: Weekend at Agnes (Sint-Martens-Bodegem) — lodging, day-trips, tech conferences

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Agnes
siblings.summary: Three B&Bs in Sint-Martens-Bodegem are walkable to Agnes. Louis 1924 is the chef's own property and ships a shuttle; De Onsemhoeve is the closest and best-reviewed; B&B Bodegem is the cheapest but the weakest.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Agnes
siblings.summary: Curated half- and full-day options around Sint-Martens-Bodegem — Brussels essentials, Pajottenland breweries and Bruegel walks, Leuven/Mechelen day-trips, family parks, and what's actually on the 30-31 May 2026 weekend.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Agnes
siblings.summary: Brussels-area IT conferences and dev meetups within ~30 km of Agnes (Sint-Martens-Bodegem) for 2026, anchored on FOSDEM, EU Open Source Week, Cybersec Europe, EuroBSDCon, and AI Summit Brussels.

sources.title: Agnes – MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Agnes is a one-star Michelin restaurant in Sint-Martens-Bodegem, housed in a former presbytery, modern French cuisine in the €€€ band.

sources.title: Restaurant Agnes by Thomas Locus
sources.claim: Agnes is at Processiestraat 3, 1700 Sint-Martens-Bodegem (chef Thomas Locus).

sources.title: Sint-Martens-Bodegem — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Sint-Martens-Bodegem is a historic village within Dilbeek municipality, Flemish Brabant.

sources.title: B&B Bodegem — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: B&B Bodegem is a 3-room adults-only lodge in Sint-Martens-Bodegem with indoor pool, hot tub, sauna; ~$120/night; cleanliness complaints (2.6/5).

sources.title: B&B Bodegem — Bedandbreakfast.eu
sources.claim: B&B Bodegem is rated 7.9/10 on Bedandbreakfast.eu — a softer view than TripAdvisor.

sources.title: Wellness B&B Bodegem (official)
sources.claim: B&B Bodegem brands itself as a wellness B&B (sauna, indoor pool, hot tub).

sources.title: Waer Waters hotel (official)
sources.claim: Waer Waters is an adults-only 4-star spa hotel at Rodenberg 21, Groot-Bijgaarden (Dilbeek) with 27 rooms, six pools and 12,000 m² wellness garden.

sources.title: Waer Waters — Expedia
sources.claim: Waer Waters is 4-star, adults-only (21+), with six pools and 12,000 m² wellness garden, 27 rooms with heated floors and Smart TVs.

sources.title: Villa Servais (official)
sources.claim: Villa Servais is a restored 19th-century neo-Palladian villa at Servaislaan 8, Halle, with 8 luxurious B&B rooms, 200 m from Halle station.

sources.title: Villa Servais — Visit Halle
sources.claim: Villa Servais was designed in 1847 by Jean-Pierre Cluysenaar for cellist Adrien François Servais; bas-reliefs by Cyprien Godebski (1864).

sources.title: Villa Servais — Brussels Morning
sources.claim: Villa Servais was acquired in 2016 by Maud and Geert de Poorter and renovated room by room after standing empty since 1981; now operates as eight-room guesthouse.

sources.title: B&B St-Hubert (official)
sources.claim: B&B St-Hubert is at Rosweg 68B, Sint-Martens-Lennik, on a working manège with Friesian horses; 5 rooms; from €110.

sources.title: T'Rest at Kasteel Ter Rijst (official)
sources.claim: T'Rest is a B&B, restaurant and event venue inside the neoclassical Kasteel Ter Rijst in Heikruis.

sources.title: B&B T'Rest — Booking.com
sources.claim: B&B T'Rest at Terrest 2, 1670 Pepingen (Heikruis); rooms from ~€85-€115/night.

sources.title: Pajottenland lodging round-up — reisroutes.be
sources.claim: Curated Pajottenland lodging round-up.

sources.title: Trionfo Guesthouse (official)
sources.claim: Trionfo is a guesthouse at Postweg 3, Lennik (Gaasbeek), at the gate of Gaasbeek Castle's park; named after Marquis Arconati's 1813 triumphal arch.

sources.title: B&B Het Verblijf (official)
sources.claim: Het Verblijf is a restored authentic Brabant three-sided farmhouse 200+ years old, walking distance to Gaasbeek.

sources.title: B&B De Windheer (official)
sources.claim: De Windheer is at Gustaaf Van Der Steenstraat 81, Gaasbeek (Lennik); 5 bedrooms including suite and wheelchair-accessible room; resident draft horse 'Prins'.

sources.title: B&B De Woestijn (official)
sources.claim: B&B De Woestijn at Roosdaal (Pamel) offers 3 deluxe rooms, heated outdoor pool, regional-product breakfast.

sources.title: De Windheer — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: De Windheer is 0.6 mi (≈1 km) from Gaasbeek Castle per TripAdvisor proximity data.

sources.title: Agnes — Gault&Millau
sources.claim: Agnes is profiled by Gault&Millau Belgium as a Sint-Martens-Bodegem fine-dining destination by Thomas Locus.

sources.title: Agnes — Visit Dilbeek
sources.claim: Dilbeek tourism office lists Agnes as a flagship local restaurant in Sint-Martens-Bodegem.

sources.title: B&B Bodegem (official)
sources.claim: B&B Bodegem official site.
